answer.origin: finance.yahoo.com article dated 2026-07-01 reporting NN, Inc.'s late-June 2026 announcement; the original NN press release or filing was not supplied, so its exact date is unknown.
answer.note: Source claim: NN, Inc. announced in late June 2026 that it is adding 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid cooling production of NVIDIA AI data center racks. NN also stated that 100% of the new capacity was already pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards and targeted US$80-90 million of accretive new business in 2026 from the expansion. For NVDA, this is a supplier-side lead about the liquid cooling supply chain for NVIDIA AI rack designs, and it is consistent with continued demand for NVIDIA-platform rack cooling content. Conditional interpretation: if the pre-sold awards are tied to NVIDIA-platform racks, they point to real downstream volume for rack-level cooling in NVIDIA-based AI systems in 2026. This does not show NVIDIA buys from NN, that NVIDIA's own orders or revenue changed, or that the awards are NVIDIA's own commitments; the article's framing of NVIDIA-related demand is not established by the quoted award terms. The NN revenue and earnings projections (US$485.5 million and US$47.9 million by 2028 in NN's narrative; about US$489.5 million and US$48.3 million from unnamed analysts) concern NN and are not NVDA evidence. The Russell Microcap Value Index removal concerns NN's trading and index status and does not bear on NVDA.
limitations: The NVIDIA link is the article's framing; the quoted award terms do not name NVIDIA or any end customer, so it is unknown whether the pre-sold capacity serves NVIDIA-platform racks directly or through intermediaries.
The announcement does not disclose the capex amount, machine cost, ramp timing, or capacity volumes in rack units, so the scale of the expansion relative to NVIDIA rack demand cannot be measured.
The 100% pre-sold statement and the US$80-90 million 2026 target are NN's own statements as reported by a media outlet; their scope and basis are not independently verified.
The original NN announcement date is not given in the supplied records; only the late-June 2026 event period and the 2026-07-01 publication date are known.
The NN revenue and earnings projections to 2028 and the unnamed analyst estimates are NN-level forecasts with unknown basis and do not inform NVDA's revenue or orders.
No NVIDIA-side disclosure of supplier relationships or rack cooling sourcing was supplied, so the business link from NN capacity to NVIDIA demand remains a hypothesis.
follow_up: Retrieve NN's original late-June 2026 press release or 8-K and check the exact announcement date, capacity details, and any named customer or NVIDIA reference.
Check whether NN's multi-year, multi-product awards identify NVIDIA, a rack integrator, or another customer, using NN's customer disclosures or earnings call transcript.
Check NVIDIA's latest filings and supplier or ecosystem disclosures for any mention of liquid cooling partners or rack cooling sourcing for Blackwell or later AI rack platforms.
Check industry or competitor liquid cooling capacity announcements for the same period to judge whether NN's pre-sold capacity is a material share of NVIDIA rack cooling supply.
